title: ee.global_memory.v1
description: Redaction-safe store-metadata for the user-global memory tier: the separate local store at <user-data-root>/global/ (its own ee.db + index) that follows the user across every workspace. Paths, flags, schema version, and a content census only; never memory content. See ADR 0081 (docs/adr/0081-user-global-memory-store.md) and bd-2vq2z.13.

databasePath.description: Absolute path to the global store database (<user-data-root>/global/ee.db).

indexDir.description: Absolute path to the global store's derived search-index directory.

present.description: Whether the global store exists on disk.

participating.description: Whether the current workspace participates in the global tier (the hard privacy boundary: participate=false blocks both contribute and consume).

schemaVersion.description: The schema/migration version of the global store; parity with the workspace store.

memoryCount.description: Number of memories in the global store.

lastModified.description: RFC 3339 last-modified timestamp of the store, or null when unknown.
